mapper.insert: insert into bu_match_policy(bu_id,match_order,version,changed_by,changed_at) values (#{buId},#{order},#{version},#{userId},utc_timestamp(6)) as desired on duplicate key update match_order=desired.match_order,version=desired.version, changed_by=desired.changed_by,changed_at=desired.changed_at
mapper.update: update requirement_match_run set current_run=null,status='superseded',lease_token=null,lease_until=null,next_attempt_at=null where project_id=#{projectId} and document_id=#{documentId} and current_run=1 and not exists (select 1 from requirement selected where selected.id=requirement_match_run.requirement_id and selected.parse_run_id is null and selected.block_id is null and selected.source_refs_json is not null)

update requirement_match_run set current_run=null,status='superseded',next_attempt_at=null,lease_token=null,lease_until=null where project_id=#{projectId} and document_id=#{documentId} and current_run=1
mapper.insert: insert into requirement_match_input(requirement_id,source_fingerprint,version,payload) values (#{requirementId},#{fingerprint},#{version},#{payload}) as desired on duplicate key update source_fingerprint=desired.source_fingerprint, version=desired.version,payload=desired.payload
mapper.select:
select r.id from requirement r left join document_block source on source.id=r.block_id
order by r.document_id, coalesce(source.block_index, 2147483647), r.id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select id from requirement_match_run where order by next_attempt_at,id limit 4
mapper.update: update requirement_match_run set status='running',lease_token=#{token},lease_until=timestampadd(second,90,utc_timestamp(6)), attempts=least(attempts+1,1000000) where id=#{id} and

update requirement_match_run set status=#{status},next_attempt_at=timestampadd(second,#{delay},utc_timestamp(6)), lease_token=null,lease_until=null,progress=#{progress} where id=#{id} and lease_token=#{token}
